title: A fixed-drive energy decrement yields finite asynchronous termination
statement: For s_i in{-1,+1}, L_i=H-b_i+sum J_ij s_j, flips only when s_i L_i<-h_i and symmetric K_ij=w_iJ_ij, E=-sum w_i(H-b_i)s_i-sum_(i<j)K_ij s_i s_j decreases by more than2w_i h_i per flip. Range B(H)=2sum w_i|H-b_i|+2sum|K_ij| bounds flips by B/(2min w_i h_i). Bounded-degree uniform parameters give O(n) flips at one fixed drive, not unique arbitration, physical settling time or useful program length.
